English.Char_Desc_2000:
Screen Markup turns any phone or tablet into a wireless drawing pad for your Windows PC. Draw on your phone or tablet and see it on your PC screen, live.
Open Screen Markup on your iPad, Android tablet or phone, draw with your finger or a stylus, and your strokes appear instantly over whatever is on your PC screen: slides, a browser, a document, a game or a video call. A live view of your PC appears on the tablet, so you always know exactly where you are drawing.
Features: - Use your phone or tablet as a drawing pad for your PC, no pen tablet needed - Live view of your PC screen on the phone or tablet, with smooth ink - Works over any network; pair in seconds - Click-through overlay, so you keep using your PC normally - Fade the drawing view; nothing is saved - Signed installer from RSW Digital Ltd, silent install supported
Great for teachers, online tutors, presenters, streamers and anyone on video calls who wants to draw, circle and highlight on screen.
7-day free trial, then GBP 10 per year or GBP 25 lifetime (plus VAT). Windows 10/11, main monitor.
